messages:
maria: Heads-up — deprec banner impressions are inflating console 'visit' counts for some tenants. saw 2x spike matching banner rollouts. @sylvia can you take a look?
jake: same. heatmap legend shows more "visits" than actual page loads. probably impression vs pageview mixup.
sylvia: looking now. do we have a repro tenant id? can we get exact telemetry event? ops-bot, can you paste latest rollouts log?
ops-bot: rollout/announce v1->v2-banner tenant=acme-tn id=roll_2026_03_20 impressions=1420 pageviews=710
maria: here's an example event we saw in logs:
```
{"tenant":"acme-tn","event":"console.visit","source":"banner_impression","path":"/routes/console/deprec","meta":{"banner_id":"roll_2026_03_20","session_id":"s-123"}}
```
jake: ah — backend is counting any console.visit event as a 'visit' for the heatmap + quota billing. that event should be an 'impression' only.
sylvia: proposing quick fix: add `event_type` discriminator (impression|pageview) and debounced dedupe by session_id for 10s. will PR. also update telemetry schema and downstream ETL mapping.
darren: can we avoid schema change? we could coerce on ingestion: if source==banner_impression then map->impression and exclude from visit counters. safer short-term.
maria: prefer short-term ingestion patch (darren) and medium-term schema + console UX change (sylvia). Also need a console copy change: 'impressions' label vs 'visits' in heatmap legend.
sylvia: working on PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987 diff adds event_type and dedupe. will include migration note for ETL.
console-bot: deploy-staging started for console telemetry API (build 4f2a). monitor: /metrics/telemetry_error_rate
jake: thx — ops, please add a one-off alert to catch >20% discrepancy between nginx access logs and telemetry.visit counts for next 48h.
ops-bot: done. alert id: TLM-3921. tagging oncall @darren :bell:
darren: on it. if alarm trips I'll mute banner rollout until we push the ingestion patch.
maria: plan approved. will roll banner to 10% pause, observe, then continue. any objections?
jake: none from infra side.
sylvia: will land PR + docs this afternoon. will post the PR link when ready.
maria: thanks all :raised_hands: closing thread when PR merged.
